hypothesis: The stronger v6 broad English substrate can acquire the four deep natural realization capabilities through existing route-selected task-cake residuals without rewriting the shared core that v19 proved vulnerable to cross-distribution interference.

measured_bottleneck.interpretation: Complete-core optimization learned portions of the natural distribution but damaged a stronger broad shared representation. The next experiment isolates acquisition updates in sparse residual cakes and makes shared-core immutability directly verifiable tensor by tensor.

hardware_policy.cpu_role: Exact deployed LayerCake inference, TTFO, throughput, active-memory, identity, and physical-sparse certification only.

validation_order: Require all 39,996 immutable records and all four capabilities to participate in successful CUDA optimizer updates.
Prove that every changed checkpoint tensor is under task_cakes and every shared-core, embedding, transformer, language-head, and route-classifier tensor is byte-identical to v6.
Export the exact teacher-free checkpoint with the unchanged generic token-run-four overlay.
Reverify checkpoint identity, canonical ABI, source absence, and physical sparse execution.
Run the locked 1,400-observation broad14 validation first on native CPU and require every gate.
Only if broad14 passes, run the 1,000-observation deep scale validation on native CPU and require every gate.
Only if both automatic suites pass, run the unchanged 112-prompt blinded paired Qwen judge on CUDA and require every teacher-relative gate.
Only then run the disclosed natural audit, corrected Phase-2 suite, repeated CPU benchmark, three paired seeds or fresh hosts, package identity, isolation, and untouched final split.
decision_rule: Reject the single task-cake candidate on any locked gate. Do not unfreeze shared parameters, add task-specific symbolic handlers, tune decoder thresholds, access final-test data, or launch a nearby cake-learning-rate sweep.
claim_boundary: This is an interference-isolation acquisition test on GPU. Its sparse trainable scope and unchanged graph do not prove fluent English, teacher equivalence, CPU dominance, or promotion without the full exact-runtime validation chain.
